{{Top|leg}}
The '''Combat Victory Accreditation''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] decoration given to exceptional [[Warship/Legends|warships]].

==History==
The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] was given this decoration and it was part of the Engagements and Decorations list on its Commemorative Christening Plate. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was also given this decoration during its time with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and it was likewise also part of the Engagements and Decorations list on its Commemorative Christening Plate.
